result_text:
I fixed the four broken default scoping conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`. The full `codeanalyzer` suite passes offline (335 run, 0 failures, 3 skipped) and includes a new test class for these rules. I did not commit.

Changes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **pkgdown / Doxygen / meta-generator HTML rules:** the path pattern was `(html|html|xhtml)`, now `(html|htm|xhtml)`. `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **.NET doc XML rule:** path pattern `.*/[.]xml` changed to `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches. The `<doc>` content check still gates it.
- **`// Generated by …` JavaScript rule:** path pattern `.*/[.]js` changed to `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches. The content check still gates it.
- **Gradle JavaScript build rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` changed to `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` was already covered by a separate rule.

I added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that the fixed files land in the right scope and that existing matches still hold. It also checks that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out.
